errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer is requested but not found in the system by customer_id.

errors.name: RoomNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a room is requested but not found in the system by room_id.

errors.name: ReservationNotFoundError

errors.name: OverlappingReservationError
errors.description: Raised when a new reservation overlaps with an existing reservation in the same room.
